content: Ayesu bhaalamia amundu jwaapolite mmele
Ayesu bhakakweela mu mtumbwi, na bhakajomboka litanda na kuhika mu chilambo chabhenji.

Ngapena bhandu bhajingi ngabhanneta mundu jwaapolite mmele goa, bhabhagonikwe nnani ja njeega. Ayesu pabhakabhona kuhobhalela kwabhenji, nga akaalobholela jonijola mundu jwaapolite, “Mwanangu nchipee ntima! Mabohu ginu gatekulekelelwa.”
Bhandu bhangi bha bhenibhala bhabhamanyanga malagilo ga Amusa bhakajemekanga konyananga akaachinabhene, “Hojo mundu atekwaaponja Annoongo!”
Ayesu akagamanya chibhatenda kuganikia, akaakonyanga, “Kwaniki ntendanga kuganikia mabohu mu mitima jinunji?
Bholi, nga niki chichibhile changalimba, kulobhola, ‘Ntekulekelelwa mabohu ginu’ au kulobhola, ‘Nnyeme nnyaule?’”

Nambo, mbala muimanyange yakubhehe amwana bha amundu bhakombola kwaalekelela bhandu mabhou gabhe pamba pachilambo. Penapo akaalobholela jonojwe mundu jwapolite mmele, “Nnyimuke ntole njeega chinu, nnyaule kwaachinu.”
Jonojwe mundu jwaapolite mmele bhakajimuka, na bhakajaula kwaachabhe.
Bhandu bhoa mu lilubhalo lyela pabhakagalola genago bhakajogopanga, bhakaalumbalila Annoongo bhabhaapekie bhandu machili ga henela.
Ayesu bhaakema Amatayo

Ayesu bhakabhoka penapo, na pabhakajaula, bhakaabhona amundu bhamo bhakemitwa Amatayo, bhatamite panyuumba ja kutochela kodi, Ayesu bhakaalobholela, “Ngagule nenga.” Na bhenabho Amatayo bhakajema, na kwaakagula.
Ayesu pabhakibha kwaachabhe Amatayo kulyee chakulya, bhakutochanga kodi bhajingi na akaabohu bhakahikanga bhakatama na kulyee nabho na bhabhachijigana bhabhe.
Mafalisayo pabhakabhona genago, bhakaakonyanga bhabhachijigana bhabhe, “Kwaniki bhannyigana bhinu bhalyee pamo na bhandu bhabhabhilinge na mabohu?”
Ayesu pabhakajoha genago, bhakaalobholelanga, “Bhandu bhanga itamwa bhaapalanga hopo ang'anga, nambo bhenibhala akaatamwa nga bhaapala ang'anga.
Bahi, nnyaulange nkachijigane maana ga malobhe aga, ‘Mbala kia, ngabha mbeeko,’ kwa maana nangahika kwaakemanga bhandu bhabhilinge bhammbone, nambo bhabhilinge na mabhou.”
Majigano nnani ja kutabha
Penapo bhabhajichigana bha Ayohana ambatichaji bhakaajabhulila Ayesu, bhakaakonya, “Tweenga na Mafalisayo tutenda kutabha mala jijingi, kwa niki bhabhachijigana bhinu ngatabha?”

Ayesu bhakaajangulanga, “Bholi, akaageni bhabhalaalikwe ku ulombela bhapakuhumalanga na kutabha pabhabhee pamo na hangwana bha ulombela? Nga henela! Nambo muda gupakuhika hangwana bha ulombela chibhapakubhokekwa nkati jabhenji, gono muda nga pabhapakutabhanga.”
“Bhandu ngatotela chibhamba cha ngobho jiyono mu ngobho ja lolo. Handa bhatenditinge henela, jenejo ngobho ja lolo jipakujonjokeka lipobhole, na jenejo ngobho jipakuhalibika muno.

Wala bhandu ngalekelanga divai jiyono mu mihuko jijilalite jijitotitwe na mambendela ga ngondolo. Handa bhatenditinge henela, divai hejo hipakuipapulana yeneyo mihuko jenejo, na divai jipakujitika na mihuko jipakupapuka. Divai jiyono jilekelwa mu mihuko miyono na henela divai na mihuko kubhee maha!”
Amwali bha akolo na mwikege bhabhalamite

Ayesu pabhatendita kulobhola genago, akolo bhamo Annyahudi bhakahika, bhakaatindibhalila majugwa na kulobhola, “Amwali bhangu bhatekujomoka nangocheni. Nambo nhike nkaabhekele lubhoko lwinu na bhenabho bhapakulama.”
Ayesu bhakajimuka na kujaula pamo na bhabhachijigana bhabhe bhakaakagula.
Na pabhatendita kujaula haikege bhamo, atamwa ncholocholo kwa yaaka komi na jibhele, bhakaakagula Ayesu kuyeto, bhakamula mbendo ja ngobho jabhe.
Kwakubhee bhakachilobholela muntima gwabhe, “Handa ngamwile tu ngobho jabhe, mbakulama.”
Ngapena Ayesu bhakatendebhuka bhakaabhona haikege, bhakaalobholela, “Amwali, nchipekee ntima! Kuhobhalela kwinu kutekunlamia.” Haikege bhenabho bhakalama popopo.
Ngapena Ayesu pabhakahika kwaachakwe bhenibhala akolo. Na bhakaabhona bhandu bhagomba hipenga ya nguto na kuguta muno,
bhakaalobholela, “Mmokange pamba! Amwali abha bhangawee, bhatekugoloka tu.” Nambo bhandu bhakaaheka.
Bahi, lilubhalo lya bhandu pabhakaabhoanga panja, Ayesu bhakajingila nkati, bhakaakamula lubhoko bhena amwali, na bhenabho bhakajema.
Bhandu bhoa bha chilambo echo bhakajoanga ngani hejo.
Ayesu bhaalamia bhangalola bhabhele
Ayesu pabhakabhoka penapo, na pabhatendita kujenda, bhangalola bhabhele bhakaakagula kongo bhabhi kupotanga nyenye, “Amwana bha Adaudi, ntukolee kia!”

Ayesu pabhakajingila mu nyuumba, bhangalola bhabhele bhakaajendelela Ayesu na bhakaakonya, “Bholi, nhobhalelanga kubhehe nenga ndenda kombola kunnamianga?” Na bhenaangota bhakaajangula, “Eloo, Hangwana.”
Penapo Ayesu bhakakwahanga miho gabhenji, bhakalobhola, “Na hibhee kwaachinunji handa chinhobhalilinge.”
Miho gabhenji ngagakajogoka kulola. Na bhenabho Ayesu bhakaakanikia muno, “Nkotokwaalobholelanga amundu bhoabhala chilebhe chenjeni.”
Nambo bhenaangota bhakabhokanga, bhakajaula kutandahaa ngani ya Ayesu mu chilambo chela choa.
Ayesu bhaalamia amundu bhangalongela
Bhandu pabhatendita kujenda kwaachabhe, bhangi bhakaaleta kwa Ayesu amundu bhangalongela ligongo bhakibha na mahoka.

Ayesu pabhakalibhoa lyenilyela lihoka, popopo bhenibhala amundu bhangalongela bhakajemeka kulongela kabhele. Bhandu bhakakachanga na kulobhola, “Chilebhe handa chenjeni changabhonekana mu chenje chilambo cha ku Isilaeli.”
Nambo Mafalisayo bhakalobhola, “Amundu abha bhatenda kugabhoa mahoka kwa machili ga akolongwa bha mahoka.”
Ayesu bhaabhonela kia bhandu
Ayesu bhakatyanga mu hilambo yoa na hijiji, na bhakajigana mu majuumba gabhenji ga konganilanga Bhayahudi, bhabhi kulongela Ngani Jammbone ja Umwenye gwa Annoongo, na kulamia bhandu itamwa yoa.
Ayesu pabhakaabhonanga bhandu mabhoga mabhoga bhakaakole kia kwa kubhehe bhakibhanga na lipamba na bhangabhee bha kwaajangatila.
Penapo bhakaalobholelanga bhabhachigana bhabhe, “Hilebhe ya kuhuna nga hijingi ila bhakuhuna na ngachoko.
Mwajopange bhenabho bhabhakweti hilebhe ya kuhuna bhaatume bhandu bhakahunange hilebhe yabhe.”
